date.as_written: nepālābde vedasindhvadriyāte (saptamyāṃ vai) phālguṇe māsi kṛṣṇe

notes: No individual is named; the colophon only states that the manuscript was caused to be written for one's own sake and the pleasure of one's chosen deity (sveṣṭaprītyai [...] lekhitaṃ svātmahetoḥ). Chronogram: veda (4) - sindhu (4) - adri (7) = NS 744.
